product_one_liner.value: Spacelift is an infrastructure orchestration platform that helps platform and DevOps teams govern and automate infrastructure-as-code deployments and ongoing infrastructure operations.
product_one_liner.notes: Homepage describes governed IaC/GitOps deployments and Day 2 operations.

pricing_page.notes: Public page lists plan options including Free and Starter.

employee_band.notes: Company careers page says 130+ co-workers; LinkedIn reports 51–200. The 130+ count fits the 101–200 band.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn lists headquarters in Redwood City, California; contact page provides its Redwood City address.

founded_year.notes: Company careers page and LinkedIn state it was founded in 2020.

eng_blog.notes: Engineering index includes multiple technical posts on worker architecture, PostgreSQL query plans, Kubernetes workers, and integrations.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation site has multiple product and developer articles; homepage/footer links to documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current openings list includes engineering/product/marketing and sales roles, but none with an AI, ML, data-science, applied-scientist, research-scientist, NLP, LLM, or computer-vision title.

model_provider.value: Anthropic, Google, OpenAI, and AWS Bedrock
model_provider.notes: Public documentation says Spacelift Intelligence supports integrations with these providers; it does not designate one single exclusive provider.

compliance_certs.notes: Security materials specifically claim SOC 2 Type II certification. GDPR alignment/compliance is not listed as a certification.

last_funding.notes: Announcement reports the $51 million Series C on July 10, 2025.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent identified funding announcement is July 2025, before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025? Actually July 2025 falls within that window, so this funding occurred within the window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Enterprise Account Executive role is listed.

launched_6mo.notes: Spacelift announced Spacelift Flows on October 29, 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: May 2026 announcement says John Henry Archer and Jonah Kowall joined as SVPs, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Career and product-documentation sources checked did not reveal a clearly attributable CRM or sales/marketing system in use.
